source_snapshot.test_set: Intel CPU RAS -UPI UPI Link Layer
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable EDKII debug/error-injection controls, deploy ITP, boot Windows, log/halt, obtain PCIe topology/port map, select target, call ei.injectUpiLLError(socket,port), run error.check_upi_errors(), resume and collect evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: OS dmesg match; BMC may record uncorrectable error; front-panel light if present; UEFI SEL may record event; Cscript must report `Error = UC LL or Phy Control Error`.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED with exact target, bounded one-shot injection, mandatory Cscript signature, recovery and restoration.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>pcie.topology() >>>pcie.port_map() 6. Check PCIe slot target >>>ei.injectUpiLLError(socket,port) >>>error.check_upi_errors() >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. Check OS dmesg reports the error that match 2. BMC error log may record uncorrectable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will Light if there is one. 4. uEFI SEL Log may record same event 5. Cscripts log(error.check_upi_errors) should record 'Error = UC LL or Phy Control Error'
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Socket 0~N (Intel UPI link-layer on Socket 0~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'upi|link.layer|crc|failover'; echo __UPI_link-layer_on_Socket_0~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.purpose: Inject a UPI link-layer fault into each approved socket/port and prove the Intel diagnostic reports the specified UC link-layer or PHY-control error, with corroborating platform logs and physical indication and successful recovery.
required_package: Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash and approved injectUpiLLError/error.check_upi_errors semantics
Exact UC LL/PHY signature plus deterministic Windows/BMC/UEFI and indicator oracle
One-shot timeout, abort, recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified FAE/operator enables the listed EDKII settings on an isolated Windows SUT, maps ITP topology to the physical UPI link, performs one approved `injectUpiLLError`, captures the complete `error.check_upi_errors()` output, resumes/recoveries the system, gathers authoritative Windows RAS, BMC and UEFI evidence plus the front-panel state, and restores settings.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Check OS dmesg reports the error that match 2. BMC error log may record uncorrectable error 3.
